definitions.speech: a KB resource labelled kind/speech (one Hansard or committee contribution)
definitions.about_topic: carries the OPAX topic label (21-topic enrichment classifier); not every speech is labelled, see coverage
definitions.chamber_speeches: a speech is a chamber record; committee-hearing turns (senate_committee, joint_committee, house_committee) are counted separately because each question-and-answer turn is its own record
definitions.speaker: the resource collaborator name (one per speech); see attribution notes
definitions.period: exact speech dates via /search created filter; decades via the decade label
definitions.parliaments: every parliament in the record unless the question names one (federal, NSW, Victoria, SA, Queensland, ACT)
definitions.money: federal AEC donation returns (portal/public/graph/money.json, top 250 donors); individual donors not named are aggregated, never ranked by name

coverage.federal_gap: Federal chamber Hansard from mid-2022 to mid-2025 is thin in the source data itself (parli.db: Wilkie 14 speeches in 2023, 1 in 2024), not only in the KB.

attribution_note: data-speaker-attribution-check (12 Oct 2026): 16,909 KB speech documents carry several speakers' words under one MP (OpenAustralia legacy markup), mostly OpenAustralia-sourced federal House and Senate debate. Sample error rates: Wilkie 13.3%, Hanson-Young 20.0%, Bandt 3.3%, Katter 3.3%, Wong 3.3%. Committee-hearing and state records come from other parsers.
